summary: Monte Rosa Therapeutics filed an 8-K under Items 7.01 and 8.01 disclosing that collaborator Novartis initiated a Phase 2 study of the VAV1-directed molecular glue degrader MRT-6160 (DDY391) in Sjögren's disease, triggering a $50 million milestone payment under their global exclusive license agreement. The company remains eligible for up to $2.1 billion in development, regulatory, and sales milestones. No securities transaction, board recommendation, or advisor is implicated. This is a routine clinical/operational update and milestone disclosure, not a special situation; watch milestone cadence and Novartis program momentum as the principal catalysts.
